recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further core FHIR work is needed for FHIR-41951 unless future tooling starts requiring explicit SearchParameter.target values for Group-member, in which case those targets should be generated or maintained consistently with Group.member.entity.
issue_request: Applied/Persuasive with Modification for R6. The issue requested adding Medication and Substance to Group.member.entity for laboratory/testing use cases, with the accepted modification also adding BiologicallyDerivedProduct and NutritionProduct, adding medication, substance, biologicallyDerivedProduct, and nutritionProduct to Group.type, and updating the Group member search parameter targets if necessary.

additional_context: FHIR-I 2024-03-18 minutes record the same modification and state that Group-member search parameter target handling might be automatic. Later FHIR-52918 extends the same area to MedicinalProductDefinition and SubstanceDefinition and is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source edit was made.
